extraction_notes: USDA weighted mean, not a single study result. Summary table analyte is the stereospecific flavan-3-ol (-)-Epicatechin. USDA documentation states flavan-3-ols are reported as catechins/epicatechins and gallate esters without the glycoside-to-aglycone conversions applied to other flavonoid classes. Full individual source papers were not retrieved in this batch.
